title: mine-flow — STEP-54.0–54.4 Findings Ledger Slice
scope: STEP-54.0 pre-flight plus every FC-54.* finding in STEP-54.1–54.4
purpose: Verified input slice for STEP-54.11 consolidation; not the final master spec or STEP close.

by_substep.result: Pre-flight record accounted for; intentionally defines no critique IDs.

FC-54.1-001.summary: The mobile shell renders the global header only on `/`, leaving group landings without the global controls available on the dashboard.

FC-54.1-002.summary: Exact/prefix route matching does not provide a selected parent state on `/tools`, `/operations`, or `/teams`.
FC-54.1-002.evidence_status: Source citation retained from finding; no restructure re-check required.

FC-54.1-003.summary: The bottom bar exposes exactly the five Doc 07 destinations and delegates feature reachability to group landings.

FC-54.1-004.summary: The sidebar can animate to zero width, but the collapsed state depends on the header toggle and lacks a persistent rail affordance.
FC-54.1-004.evidence_status: Source citation retained; runtime keyboard/visual behavior remains unverified.

FC-54.1-005.summary: Several features either lack form routes or bypass existing GoRouter routes with `MaterialPageRoute`, so URL-backed form/detail reconstruction is incomplete.
FC-54.1-005.evidence_status: Re-resolved from the finding body and §5 route table; the original evidence cell says only “Citations in the Finding column.”
FC-54.1-005.candidate_step_55_account: 55.0 route adapter plus the applicable feature substeps 55.2–55.9.

FC-54.1-006.summary: Report actions push a standalone route with `ReportType` in `state.extra`, and refresh can fall back to the type picker instead of preserving feature context.
FC-54.1-006.candidate_step_55_account: 55.1 shared report dialog plus feature integrations.

FC-54.1-007.summary: Shell surfaces intentionally retain a narrow documented Material interoperability boundary that new sheet/dialog work must not expand.

FC-54.1-008.summary: Shell, navigation, group, and header strings remain hardcoded and therefore do not follow locale changes consistently.
FC-54.1-008.evidence_status: Source citation retained from finding; already within RISK-0004.
FC-54.1-008.candidate_step_55_account: 55.10; reconcile with RISK-0004 rather than opening a duplicate risk.

FC-54.1-009.summary: Static semantics do not prove contrast, target size, focus order, text scaling, reduced motion, or dark-mode quality.
FC-54.1-009.evidence_status: Blocker retained: no valid runtime artifact in 54.1.

FC-54.1-010.summary: Source uses a consistent 800dp branch, but behavior at and around the breakpoint is not proven at runtime.
FC-54.1-010.evidence_status: Blocker retained: no runtime width sweep in 54.1.

FC-54.2-001.summary: The cut/fill report action opens the standalone report route and does not carry the active date/zone filters.

FC-54.2-002.summary: Create and edit open a full `MaterialPageRoute` form rather than the responsive sheet contract.

FC-54.2-003.summary: The router has `/operations/cut-fill` but no create/edit form child route.

FC-54.2-004.summary: The BLoC tracks unsaved changes, but visible dismiss controls pop directly and the form has no `PopScope`/`WillPopScope` guard.
FC-54.2-004.evidence_status: Re-resolved: `cut_fill_bloc.dart:94-103,211-220`; `cut_fill_form_screen.dart:180-185,253-259`; whole-file guard scan returned none.

FC-54.2-005.summary: The cut/fill list/form retain Material FAB, date picker, and text-field primitives outside the target ForUI vocabulary.

FC-54.2-006.summary: Scalar cut/fill records can continue opening edit directly; a separate read-only inspector is not justified.
FC-54.2-006.candidate_step_55_account: Preserve as the D7 “no inspector” decision in 55.2.

FC-54.2-007.summary: Static labels do not prove touch targets, contrast, or focus behavior.
FC-54.2-007.evidence_status: Blocker retained: no runtime artifact in 54.2.

FC-54.3-001.summary: Create/edit use `MaterialPageRoute` and the form has no URL-backed sheet or dirty-dismiss guard.
FC-54.3-001.evidence_status: Re-resolved: `land_clearing_list_screen.dart:145-168,404-427`; `land_clearing_entry_screen.dart:247-268`; whole-file guard scan returned none.

FC-54.3-002.summary: `DefaultTabController`/`TabBar` state is local, so form reconstruction does not retain the selected Plan/Actual tab.
FC-54.3-002.evidence_status: Source citation retained. Treat as form-state preservation, not as a substitute for the missing form route in FC-54.3-001.
FC-54.3-002.candidate_step_55_account: 55.3; choose a stable route/query or explicit restoration contract.

FC-54.3-003.summary: The selection-only CF-043 contract is preserved, but the shared combobox always renders an inline list rather than adapting to mobile.
FC-54.3-003.evidence_status: Static structure resolves at `creatable_combobox.dart:319-362`; keyboard-occlusion impact remains unverified.
FC-54.3-003.candidate_step_55_account: 55.3 platform adaptation; verify occlusion in 55.11 before claiming a runtime defect.

FC-54.3-004.summary: The report action pushes the standalone report route and does not preserve list filters.

FC-54.3-005.summary: Form/list surfaces retain Material tabs, date pickers, FABs, and text fields outside the target component vocabulary.

FC-54.3-006.summary: A record tap opens the mixed Plan/Actual edit form directly, so the critique selects a read-only inspector before edit.
FC-54.3-006.evidence_status: Re-resolved: `land_clearing_list_screen.dart:400-427`. The original role-specific rationale (“field workers only…”) is not established by this citation and must not be carried forward as fact.
FC-54.3-006.candidate_step_55_account: 55.3 inspector-sheet implementation, justified by inspection/edit separation and accidental-edit risk.

FC-54.3-007.summary: Tabs, summary cards, contrast, targets, and dark mode were not exercised at runtime.
FC-54.3-007.evidence_status: Blocker retained: no runtime artifact in 54.3.

FC-54.4-001.summary: Failed coordinate projection can reach submit and is persisted as latitude/longitude `0.0, 0.0`, creating a data-integrity defect.
FC-54.4-001.candidate_step_55_account: 55.4 priority-zero validation fix and targeted tests.

FC-54.4-002.summary: The benchmark form is a full routed `FScaffold`, not the required Web right sheet/mobile bottom sheet.
FC-54.4-002.evidence_status: Re-resolved: `benchmark_form_screen.dart:165-195`. **Qualification:** the original claim that this necessarily obscures the shell/sidebar is not supported; the route is nested under the shell.
FC-54.4-002.candidate_step_55_account: 55.0 and 55.4; carry only the sheet-contract mismatch, not the obscured-shell claim.

FC-54.4-003.summary: Benchmark surfaces retain Material FAB, refresh, and dropdown primitives.

FC-54.4-004.summary: Back/cancel paths dismiss without consulting dirty state, and the form has no universal pop guard.
FC-54.4-004.evidence_status: Source citation retained: `benchmark_form_screen.dart:165-188`; whole-file guard scan returned none.

FC-54.4-005.summary: The delete control is a 20dp icon in a bare gesture detector without a demonstrated 48dp target.

FC-54.4-006.summary: Benchmark reporting pushes the standalone route instead of opening a contextual dialog.

FC-54.4-007.summary: The form route exists, but edit identity is supplied only through `state.extra`, so refresh/deep-link reconstruction cannot recover the selected benchmark.

FC-54.4-008.summary: CRS labels omit datum context and projection failure copy does not explain how to recover.

FC-54.4-009.summary: Empty/error visuals, keyboard insets, target geometry, and dark-mode contrast were not exercised at runtime.
FC-54.4-009.evidence_status: Blocker retained: no runtime artifact in 54.4.

FC-54.1-005.adjudication: The route gaps resolve, but the original evidence cell is not self-contained; use the citations in the finding text and source route table.

FC-54.3-006.adjudication: Direct-to-edit behavior resolves. Do not carry the uncited assertion about planner/field-worker role exclusivity into the specification.

FC-54.4-002.adjudication: Full FScaffold versus responsive sheet resolves. Strike the unsupported “obscures the shell/sidebar” clause.

cross_finding_reconciliation.decision: FC-54.1-005 is the umbrella D5 finding; preserve feature-specific IDs for local traceability.
FC-54.1-006 is the umbrella D6 finding; preserve feature-specific IDs for each integration.
Adopt the universal D4 guard without inferring one shared dirty-state implementation; current feature evidence differs.
Benchmark reporting is present and must be listed as needing D6 migration; it is not a deliberate report absence.
Retain Unverified status until later runtime evidence explicitly closes each blocker.
